newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police seize heroin and hashish.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police seize heroin and hashish.

text.p: Turkish police have seized 45 kg (99 lb) of pure heroin and 15 kg of (33 lb) of hashish worth about $860,000 buried in a garden in the eastern city of Van, state-run Anatolian news agency said.
Two people, a father and son, were arrested, the agency said. It did not say when the incidents took place.
Turkey is one of the major transit countries for the smuggling of heroin from Iran, Pakistan and Afghanistan on its way to Europe.
